bills.title: Requires just cause for employment termination and restricts the use of electronic monitoring for disciplinary purposes
Repeals the tax exempt status of private universities that receive real property tax exemptions of one hundred million dollars or more
Relates to owner liability for construction industry wage theft
Relates to placing limitations on initial regulated rents
Creates a private right of action for improper debt collection procedures
Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
Includes certain persons engaged in a professional or teaching capacity in or for a religious, charitable or educational institution as employees for purposes of eligibility for paid family leave
Relates to the right to unemployment benefits based on employment with certain educational institutions; repealer
Enacts the "advancing rights for talent, independence, services and tenure (ARTIST) act"
Authorizes a claimant to receive a dependent allowance in addition to unemployment insurance benefits
Relates to registration fees for certain motor vehicles; repealer
Directs the department of labor to post on its internet website and annually update the names of employers who employ 50 or more employees who receive public assistance
Protects tenants displaced due to fire
Relates to authorization for boycott-based adverse actions by affected state entities and public retirement systems
Relates to requiring delivery network company workers have access to paid sick leave
Relates to workers' compensation benefits for delivery network company workers
Increases the unemployment insurance minimum weekly benefit amount
Extends the duration of unemployment insurance benefits
Relates to the calculation of a claimant's weekly unemployment insurance benefit
Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a place of worship
Requires gas and electric corporations to provide forty-five days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
Relates to requiring landlords to return security deposits within a reasonable time
Relates extending provisions of law relating to physical therapy assistant services in public and private primary and secondary schools
Permits New York city voters to sign designating petitions for multiple candidates for the same New York city municipal public office or party position
Establishes the University of the State of New York environmental sustainability office
Prohibits employers from using workplace surveillance tools to surveil employees in private, off-duty areas or a worker's residence, vehicle or property
